Omnitron - Self-Aware Robotics Factory

Omnitron - 100

In Play: 

Trash:

Start of Turn: Flip.

Play a Card: S-84 Automaton Drone enters play.

End of Turn: Disintegration Ray enters play.

S-84 deals Ra or Fanatic (maybe Fanatic?) 4 energy damage.

-------------------------------------------------------

Omnitron - 100

In Play: S-84 Automaton Drone - 4

Disintegration Ray

Trash: 

Effects: ST: Flip Omnitron.

ST: Omnitron deals 5 energy damage to the hero target with the highest HP.

ET: Play the top card of the villain deck (this turn)/reveal a drone or component from the trash (next turn).

ET: S-84 deals energy damage equal to its health to the hero target with the highest HP.

7 or more damage in a round destroys components.

Hero HP: Fixer - 28, Ra - 30, Bunker - 29, Fanatic - 27
